targetType.description: Optional generic device type. Evidence-aware lighting decisions must use light.

actionValue.description: Optional immutable echo of the exact typed request value. Arrays and objects are compared structurally by the server. It is present in a full receipt exactly when the request action carried value.

actionIndex.description: Immutable zero-based batch action identity. Required for every item in the full batch view.

commandSentAt.description: Optional Unix epoch time in milliseconds when the physical command was sent. New-layer confirmation compares read-back time with this value.

decisionAt.description: Server time in milliseconds when the evidence-aware decision was made.

commandSent.description: Whether this evidence-aware decision sent a physical command.

decisionTerminal.description: Whether the evidence-aware decision is final. For skipped or blocked decisions it is always true: no physical command or confirmation is pending.

decision.description: Optional server decision for the evidence-aware layer. skipped avoids a duplicate command, executed sends the requested command or reports that it would be sent when dryRun=true, reasserted safely repeats turn_on for suspect lighting, and blocked sends no command.

reassertKey.description: Echo of the client-supplied durable idempotency key for one bounded reassert attempt. Retries and restart recovery must reuse it only with the exact same request identity and receipt payload.

reassertAttempt.description: Bounded reassert attempt number; only the first attempt is contractually allowed.

evidenceRevision.description: Optional opaque final revision of the device evidence after this decision.

reasonCode.description: Optional machine-readable reason for the server decision. Unknown values are opaque and must fail closed.

commandSource.description: Optional server-declared origin of the action decision. Automation turn-off requires confirmed automatic ownership; manual commands are not granted automatic ownership.

preCommandEvidenceRevision.description: Optional opaque revision of the evidence snapshot captured before the command.

ownership.description: Optional final server attribution from the evidence snapshot. Unknown ownership never grants automatic turn-off permission.

preCommandOwnership.description: Optional server attribution captured before the command.

blockedReasons.description: Optional machine-readable reasons for a blocked or restricted action.

evidence.description: Optional final server-owned state evidence snapshot associated with the receipt.

preCommandEvidence.description: Optional server-owned state evidence snapshot captured before the command.

lightingProfileId.description: Stable configured light-profile identity. Manual-priority receipts bind their automatic target and blocker to this profile.

lightingProfileRevision.description: Stable bounded revision of the server-owned configured light profile. Manual-priority receipts must use the revision validated by the runtime.

profileSnapshot.description: The runtime validates this snapshot against canonical server-owned configured profile storage. Client or planner data is not authoritative.

blockingEvidence.description: Explicit manual-priority evidence for one interchangeable light source. Its target may match or differ from the automatic receipt target only when the profile identity matches.

manualPriority.description: Manual-priority binding between the automatic receipt target and its server-owned blocking evidence.

targetId.description: Target bound to this read-back evidence.

observedValue.description: Typed value observed after the physical command. Confirmed appearance actions require an exact type and value match with actionValue.

commandRequestId.description: Request ID of the physical command associated with this read-back.

evidenceSequence.description: Evidence sequence associated with this read-back.

isNewEvidence.description: Whether this read-back created evidence newer than the pre-command snapshot.

evidenceRevision.description: Optional evidence revision observed after the command.
